pages.title: What are Comments?
pages.content: Comments are lines in your code that Python ignores. They help you explain your code to others (and to your future self). Use the `#` symbol to create a single-line comment.

pages.title: Single-line Comments
pages.content: Everything after `#` on that line is ignored by Python:
pages.code:
# This is a comment
print("Hello")  # This prints Hello

# The line below won't run:
# print("This is hidden")

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: Which symbol starts a comment in Python?
pages.explanation: Python uses # to start a single-line comment.
